profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer at WB Games(Avalanche).
profile.summary: Advanced Software Engineer and Graphic Artist worked in the Video Game Industry for 20 plus years. Worked with proprietary and commercial game engines. Experience in multiple disciplines including engine programming and code optimization, tools programming and tools pipelines. With specializations in animation programming and gameplay tools support.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Games included: Hogwarts Legacy and Cars 3,
* Working heavily with Unreal Engine 4. Working in multiple disciplines: primarily focused on animation.

positions.title: Principal Programmer
positions.description:
* Games included: Disney Infinity series, Toy Story 3, Cars 2
* Wrote Maya plug-ins to support getting game content into a proprietary game engine.
* Wrote proprietary tools and scripts to support animation, asset management, game-play mechanics, and character combat in a proprietary game engine.
* Worked with multiple disciplines while working in game engine development. Disciplines such as animation, physics, and game-play.
* Was involved in optimizations to improve real-time game performance and memory overhead.

Patents 
Patent # US 20100123723 A1
System and Method for Dependency Graph Evaluation for Animation
Authors: Collard, Bryant E.; Edwards, Bradley A.; Jones, Antony K.; et al.

positions.title: Senior Artist/ Senior Programmer
positions.description:
* Games included: Rug Rats and Prince of Persia
* Designed shell art and menus, characters, and levels.
* Games included: Tak and the Power of Juju series
* Wrote pipeline tools to export content from Maya to Avalanche's proprietary game engine. 
* Wrote Maya plug-ins to support level architects in world-building.
* Co-wrote proprietary tools  to deliver assets to the game engine.

positions.title: Graphic Artist
positions.description: Game and Movie promotional artwork. Clients included Universal, Sony, Naughty Dog, and SingleTrac.
